speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the dysuria, sexual history, and normal urinary labs, do you have any vaginal discharge, abnormal bleeding, or fever? REQUEST TEST: Cervical Swab for Chlamydia/Gonorrhea and Pregnancy Test.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Appendicitis. The combination of severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, dysuria (likely due to irritation of the bladder by an inflamed appendix), and a sexually active history with normal infectious workup strongly suggests appendicitis, which can present atypically in young women with pelvic pain.
